instruction: Configure VLC to automatically start in fullscreen mode by default, regardless of whether a video is playing.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC does not have a setting to launch the application itself in fullscreen mode when no media is playing. While VLC has options to start videos in fullscreen when media begins playing, there is no preference to make the empty VLC interface (with no media loaded) open in fullscreen mode. The fullscreen mode in VLC is specifically tied to video playback, not the application window itself.
